ADDENDUM (Enforcement Rules of the Organization of the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology and Its Affiliated Agencies) <No. 1, March 4, 2008>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.
Articles 2 through 4 Omitted.
Article 5 (Amendment of Other Statutes) (1) through (16) Omitted.
(17) Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Regulations on the Establishment and Operation of Technical Colleges shall be amended as follows:
In Article 2 (1), "Minister of Education" shall be replaced with "Minister of Education, Science and Technology."
In Articles 3, 4 (1), the former part of paragraph (2), Articles 5 and 6, Article 9 (1), and Article 12, "Minister of Education and Human Resources Development" shall each be replaced with "Minister of Education, Science and Technology."
(18) through (63) Omitted.
